sloka: ततस्ते विमुखाः सर्वे पतिता धरणीतले ।रणात्स्वपुरुषैः शीघ्रं गृहाण्येव प्रवेशिताः ।। ७.२३.४९ ॥
transliteration: tataste vimukhāḥ sarve patitā dharaṇītale ।raṇātsvapuruṣaiḥ śīghraṁ gṛhāṇyeva praveśitāḥ ।। 7.23.49 ॥

translations.english: Then, all of them, defeated and fallen to the ground, were quickly brought back into their homes by their own men from the battlefield.
